- Standalone inorganic pigments revenue declined to Rs 164 Crores from Rs 175 Crores, so consolidated pigment growth rested entirely on the subsidiary's newly commissioned capacity. The legacy pigments stream is contracting while surfactants carry group growth.
- Surfactants and specialities grew 14% to Rs 489 Crores and led overall 9% revenue growth, making group performance dependent on one stream; the Company reports it has already achieved optimum capacity utilisation at Ranipet and only further improved utilisation at Naidupeta, so incremental volume growth from existing assets is limited.

- Operations are concentrated at Ranipet and Ambattur in Tamil Nadu and Naidupeta in Andhra Pradesh, with all seven wind turbine generators sited at three locations in Tamil Nadu supplying the Ranipet and Ambattur plants; a regional disruption would affect both production and captive power at once.
